trials.instrumentation: CDB x86 second-chance capture; owned diagnostic break and all-thread stack; read-only context snapshots
trials.outcome_note: Final AV occurs during LdrShutdownProcess after ExitProcess(-1); not proof SourceMod caused the initiating failure.
trials.interruption_note: Paused with second Steam WebUI assertion open. User confirms no interaction. No after-map kick or quit sent. Later resume/exit trigger is unknown.

trials.instrumentation: external read-only module/code snapshots; no debugger
trials.experiment_label: vanilla map-change control without debugger, sv_lan 1
limitations: Collector raised Disconnect not confirmed while server appeared alive; later disappeared. Actual exit code was not retained. Not counted as clean exit or confirmed AV.

trials.instrumentation: CDB first and second chance trace, attached after map; supplemental retained process handle
trials.experiment_label: vanilla map-change control, late CDB, sv_lan 1
trials.outcome_note: After first AV, continued not-handled; Steam worker termination assertion appeared during ExitProcess(-1). Agent selected Retry once; final engine AV followed. No quit command.

supplemental_exit.note: Original collector errored while an assert modal blocked DLL detach. Supplemental observer waited for signaled completion. Its obsolete already_exited_at_attach field meant requested status was available, not process completion.

trials.shutdown_trigger: unexpected exit during real-client disconnect, before quit
trials.instrumentation: CDB first/second chance trace and 3 hardware write watchpoints; no process data/code writes
trials.outcome_note: Watched object first words written in SteamGameServer_Shutdown path at map change; no watched context+4 replacement before subsequent use. Agent selected Ignore on recorded WebUI assert, disabling assert dialogs for this process only. Final actual exit c0000005, collector and supplemental signaled handle agree.
